name: pi-vision-bridge-tomoyo
description: Vision bridge for text-only models (e.g. DeepSeek V4 Flash): images pasted into the chat and screenshots are described by a cheap vision model (MiniMax M3 via opencode.go) and fed to the main model as text. Registers a describe_image tool for on-demand screenshot understanding. Capability-aware: bypasses itself when the main model supports images.
